blocks.text: MANILA, Philippines — Vice President Sara Duterte on Tuesday accused the Marcos administration of linking her to allegations of Chinese funding, a drug bust in Laos, and a purported travel authority to build a narrative intended to undermine her. In a statement, she criticized the House of Representatives prosecution team for its alleged failure to establish a convincing case of an impeachable offense against her, saying “all it could offer were wacky poses that were neither entertaining nor amusing.” “Now, we are witnessing an apparent shift in the government’s narrative in taking me down, attempting to reframe the matter as a […]...
